Minimum fields: source_id; issuer; instrument_type; gazette_id; exact_locator; source_url; document_hash
Design rule: Official Gazette / regulator notification has authority; a navigation page is only a discovery source
Reason / example: Prevent unsupported rules from becoming tasks

Minimum fields: valid_from; valid_to; published_at; discovered_at; supersedes; savings; future_effective
Design rule: Track legal validity separately from when the system learned the fact
Reason / example: Preserve past-period filings and future readiness

Design rule: A family is a packaging/navigation unit, not one law count or one obligation
Reason / example: Do not inflate coverage by splitting documents

Minimum fields: obligation_id; duty_holder; action; legal_basis; object; frequency; trigger; exception
Design rule: Separate every legally distinct duty, while linking shared records / returns
Reason / example: Tax payment, filing, certificate and reconciliation are different

Minimum fields: entity_facts; thresholds; temporal_basis; appropriate_government; exemptions; decision; reason
Design rule: Use true / false / unknown; unknown creates a question or review, not automatic non-applicability
Reason / example: Headcount and turnover must be time-window-specific

Minimum fields: legal_entity; GSTIN; establishment; employee; contractor; product; asset; transaction; licence
Design rule: Scope obligations to the correct subject and responsible legal entity
Reason / example: One company may have many establishment-specific instances

Minimum fields: period_basis; relative_clock; calendar; extensions; authority; effective_window; event_timestamp
Design rule: Do not store a universal fixed due date at family level
Reason / example: Generate due dates from versioned rules and facts

Minimum fields: artifact_id; authority; instrument; jurisdiction; form_number; version; fields; validation; signature
Design rule: Form number alone is not a unique key; SS XXIII differs from OSH XXIII
Reason / example: Schema update is separate from obligation update

Minimum fields: obligation_id; artifact_id; purpose; issuer; required_fields; shared_data; substitution_authority
Design rule: Many obligations can share a register; one obligation can need several artifacts
Reason / example: Data reuse is not proof of legal substitution

Minimum fields: instance_id; obligation_version; subject; period/event; due_at; assigned_role; workflow
Design rule: An obligation definition generates dated/event-specific work items
Reason / example: Supports the previously discussed obligation workbench

Minimum fields: inputs; connectors; transformations; checks; approvals; filing_channel; idempotency_key
Design rule: Calculation automation, submission access and substantive control completion are separate
Reason / example: Prevent duplicate filings and unauthorised actions

Minimum fields: evidence_id; source; hash; created_at; subject; period; validator; signature; retention; access
Design rule: Validate evidence against subject/period/action; protect sensitive case data
Reason / example: A document upload does not prove compliance

Minimum fields: identified; applicability_review; applicable; prepared; approved; submitted; accepted; paid; verified
Design rule: Accepted, paid and legally complete need not coincide

Minimum fields: source_change; provisions; obligations; predicates; templates; open/future_instances; customer_actions
Design rule: Track amendment propagation end to end with human approval
Reason / example: Measure affected instances, not merely number of alerts

Minimum fields: reviewer; review_status; interpretation; conflict; test_cases; approved_at; next_review
Design rule: No production activation until source, applicability, timing and evidence tests pass
Reason / example: Separate extracted suggestion from approved legal rule

Minimum fields: provider; documented_api; scope; credentials; user_consent; allowed_actions; approval_policy
Design rule: No assumed public API or bypass of OTP/CAPTCHA/DSC
Reason / example: A portal URL is not an integration contract

Minimum fields: data_class; tenant; access; purpose; residency; retention; legal_hold; audit_log
Design rule: POSH, health, KYC and SDD need restricted access beyond ordinary task evidence
Reason / example: Do not let broad compliance users see all sensitive records

Minimum fields: families; approved_sources; approved_obligations; applicability_branches; schemas; executed_instances
Design rule: Report each metric separately with numerator, denominator and audit status
Reason / example: Do not market artifact bundles as individually verified statutory forms
